context: Tests whether PhotoKit guidance owns selection, explicit library access, camera capture, and image handling without absorbing playback or cache architecture.

checklist.name: Picker ownership
checklist.description: Keeps PhotosPicker or PHPickerViewController selection and PhotosPickerItem loading in PhotoKit scope.

checklist.name: Library ownership
checklist.description: Keeps PHPhotoLibrary authorization, limited access, and custom asset browsing in PhotoKit scope.

checklist.name: Camera ownership
checklist.description: Keeps AVCaptureSession camera configuration and capture lifecycle in the camera-capture portion of the skill.

checklist.name: Playback handoff
checklist.description: Routes detailed AVPlayer and playback-session behavior to AVKit or dedicated AVFoundation playback guidance.

checklist.name: Caching handoff
checklist.description: Routes production remote-image cache architecture to dedicated image-loading or networking guidance while retaining display downsampling advice.

checklist.name: Permission boundary
checklist.description: Does not require full photo-library access for the picker-only path and requests explicit access only for full-library operations.
